name: NotePlan
tagline: Plan your day with Markdown notes, tasks, and calendar events in one workspace.
description:
NotePlan combines Markdown notes, to-dos, and calendar events in a daily planning workspace. It is designed for people who want to write the day’s plan in a note and see commitments beside it, instead of maintaining disconnected task and note systems.

Open a daily note, add tasks and context in Markdown, then schedule or reschedule work against the calendar. Links, tags, filters, and project notes connect daily action to longer-running plans.

## Features

- Write daily and project notes in Markdown with linked references.
- Manage tasks, recurring items, review lists, and custom filters.
- View calendar events beside notes and time-block work.
- Sync notes across Apple devices using supported iCloud or CloudKit options.

## Where it fits

NotePlan fits people who plan by day and want tasks attached to written context. Its flexibility rewards a consistent personal system, but the subscription may be more than a simple checklist requires.

## Privacy and requirements

Notes are stored as local plain-text files on Mac and can sync through iCloud Drive or CloudKit, depending on configuration. Calendar access is needed for event views; optional web and AI features involve additional services. Confirm which sync mode is active before storing private information.

## Pricing

NotePlan has a trial. The current direct plans list $12 monthly or $99 yearly, which is $8.33 per month when billed annually.
